subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (redlines)
body:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (for review)

Hi Alina,

As discussed on the POC check-in, attaching Redwood’s standard customer quote + logo release for the case study / customer story page.

Two things we want to align on up front:
1) Scope: website story page + downloadable PDF version of the same story (no paid ads).
2) Quotes: we’ll include only the quotes explicitly listed/approved in the release.

Can you share your preferred withdrawal language (if any) and whether QuantaPay has a standard logo usage policy we should follow?

Thanks,
Priyom

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-QuantaPay_Customer-Quote-Logo-Release_v1.docx (Word document)


From: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@quantapay.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 10:04 AM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (for review)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — we reviewed. A few comments before we can route internally:

1) Withdrawal: We need a clear right to revoke consent on notice (30 days is fine). Also: remove any language that suggests we can’t withdraw once published.

2) Quotes: We need the exact approved quote text enumerated in the agreement (not “examples” or “as may be selected”).

3) Logo usage scope: Please limit to (a) Redwood website, (b) Redwood sales materials shared 1:1, and (c) the PDF version of the same case study. Exclude paid advertisements, press releases, social posts, conference booths/signage, and partner marketplace promotions unless we separately approve in writing.

4) Term: Please cap term to 12 months.

I’ve attached our marked copy.

Regards,
Alina

Alina Chen
Head of Legal, QuantaPay

Attachment: QuantaPay_release_redline_marked.pdf (PDF)


From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 11:01 AM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (for review)

Hi Alina,

Appreciate the fast turnaround — I can work with most of these.

A couple clarifications/questions so we land it cleanly:

1) Withdrawal language: We’re fine to add a right to revoke consent on 30 days’ written notice. The one nuance we usually include is: (i) we’ll stop new use promptly and (ii) we’ll take down/replace web materials within a reasonable period, but we can’t practically “recall” already-distributed copies of sales decks/PDFs that were shared before the withdrawal notice.

Would you be comfortable with a clause like:
- “QuantaPay may revoke this consent upon thirty (30) days’ written notice. Redwood will cease further use and will remove the content from its website within ten (10) business days after the effective date of revocation; provided that Redwood will not be required to retrieve or destroy materials distributed prior to the effective date of revocation.”

2) Quotes enumerated: Agreed. We’ll include an exhibit listing the exact approved quote(s) and attributed spokesperson/title.

3) Logo usage scope: Understood. We can limit to Redwood website + 1:1 sales materials + the PDF version. For avoidance of doubt, our marketing team sometimes reposts a link on LinkedIn when a customer story goes live — do you want that explicitly excluded (no social at all) or permitted only with separate written approval each time?

4) Term: 12 months works.

I’ll send a revised redline shortly.

Best,
Michael

Michael Grant
General Counsel, Redwood Inference


From: Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (for review)

Michael,

Thanks. On social: please exclude for now. Our comms team is very strict about outbound announcements and we have separate approvals for any public posts.

On withdrawal: the “no recall” concept is fine, but we need the ability to require removal from the web + stop using in materials going forward.

Also on logos: we need to specify which logo file/version will be used (we can provide our approved SVG). Please avoid any alteration besides resizing.

-Morgan

Morgan Ruiz
Director, Corporate Marketing, QuantaPay


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 12:03 PM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (for review)

Looping in a note for the quote exhibit: we can keep it tight.

Current draft approved-quote candidates (exact text TBD pending Dev/Morgan sign-off):
- Quote #1 (performance/latency) attributed to Dev Patel, VP Eng
- Quote #2 (operational reliability / Dedicated capacity) attributed to Dev Patel
- Optional quote #3 (business impact) attributed to [TBD]

We’ll send the exhibit with exact wording and will avoid broad claims.

Soojin

Soojin Lee
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference


From: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>, Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 1:18 PM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (revised redline)

Alina/Morgan,

Per Michael’s notes, attached is a revised Redwood redline (v2) that:
- Adds 30-day revocation right + 10 business day web takedown commitment
- Clarifies no obligation to retrieve materials distributed prior to effective revocation date
- Narrows the “Permitted Uses” to: (a) Redwood website case study page, (b) downloadable PDF of the same case study, and (c) Redwood sales materials shared 1:1 with prospective customers
- Explicitly excludes: paid ads, press releases, social media posts, conference signage/booths, and partner marketplace promotions without separate written approval
- Adds a 12-month term
- Adds “no alteration” to logos other than sizing/formatting; customer to provide the approved logo asset
- Adds Exhibit A for exact approved quote(s)

If this is close, we can convert to DocuSign with Exhibit A populated once you confirm the final quote text.

Best,
Sofia

Sofia Mendes
Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-QuantaPay_Customer-Quote-Logo-Release_v2_(Redwood redline).docx (Word document)


From: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>
To: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@quantapay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 2:37 PM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (revised redline)

Sofia,

This is materially better. Two remaining items:

1) Revocation/takedown timeline: 10 business days is acceptable if it is “commercially reasonable efforts” for non-website sales materials going forward (i.e., stop using). We also want a contact email for sending revocation notices.

2) Exhibit A: Please provide the exact quote text and attribution. Dev is okay being named, but please list title as “VP, Engineering” (not “VP Eng”).

On the logo: we’ll provide the approved SVG + usage guidelines once we’re aligned on the final scope.

Thanks,
Alina


From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alina Chen <alina.chen@quantapay.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Ruiz <morgan.ruiz@quantapay.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@quantapay.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 10, 2025 at 4:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay — customer quote & logo release (next steps)

Alina,

Agreed on both points.

1) Revocation: We’ll add (a) a notice email address (legal@redwoodinference.com) and (b) language that Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to cease further use in sales materials (i.e., we’ll stop distributing updated versions and will remove from our internal enablement repository), while maintaining the “no recall” protection for anything already distributed prior to the effective date.

2) Exhibit A: Soojin will send the proposed final quote text + attribution as a separate attachment for your review today/tomorrow AM. We’ll reflect title exactly as “VP, Engineering.”

Once Exhibit A is approved, we’ll send via DocuSign.

Best,
Michael

Michael Grant
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Approved_Quotes_List_QuantaPay_v0.3.docx (Word document)
